layout: Eleven individual transparent pose images matching ashen-stray-front and ashen-brood-front; CSS supplies movement. The legacy bite filename contains the Moorhueter root-claw lunge.

prompts.prompt: Create a NEW SALZMOOR / Salt Marsh battle arena background for dark fantasy RPG DarkReturn. Attached image is STYLE AND CAMERA reference only: match polished painterly semi-realistic game art, very wide panoramic framing approximately 2.5:1 (1967x800), horizon around 45 percent height, lower 55 percent mostly empty flat playable arena. NEW ENVIRONMENT: ancient sunken lowland swamp under pale gray-green mist, gnarled drowned trees framing both edges, shallow salty water channels and white salt crusts along edges, distant broken tree silhouettes receding in layered fog, very sparse pale cyan will-o-wisps over distant water, mossy roots and reeds at foreground corners. The center and lower middle must be a broad CLEAR firm wet silt clearing for three enemies, not covered with deep water or clutter. Cool desaturated green-gray palette, damp atmosphere, readable lighting and muted water reflections. No volcanic mountains, lava, fire, ruins or castles. No characters, monsters, text, UI or border. Fill whole panorama.

Create a NEW monster species MOORHÜTER / MIRE GUARDIAN for dark fantasy RPG DarkReturn. Attached monster is ONLY a rendering quality and full-body FRONT CAMERA reference, NOT the design to copy. New creature: ancient hulking swamp guardian made of gnarled waterlogged wood and twisted roots, squat hunched humanoid with TWO legs and TWO massive long arms ending in broad three-fingered root claws. Trunk-like torso, wooden face with hollow PALE CYAN eyes and broad jagged bark mouth, short forked root antlers instead of stone horns, thick moss hanging from shoulders, sparse reeds growing on back, white salt encrustations along forearms and shoulders, tiny pale cyan bioluminescent seams in chest. Damp dark brown wood and muted olive moss, weathered gray-green, clear organic silhouette. Not a wolf, not a rock golem, no stone armor, orange lava or fur. IDLE pose: front-facing, hunched over slightly, feet planted wide, long arms hanging down ready to strike, entire body visible. Same detailed polished semi-realistic game sprite rendering and soft neutral lighting as reference. Square 1254x1254 canvas, root tips at 7 percent from top, feet at 94 percent, generous side margins. No scenery, floor, text, particles or UI. Genuine transparent alpha background.

Edit attached MOORHÜTER / MIRE GUARDIAN idle sprite into ATTACK frame. Preserve EXACT same root-and-bogwood monster identity, forked antlers, hanging olive moss, reeds, white salt crusts and pale cyan eyes and chest seams, polished semi-realistic art, square canvas and front camera. Pose: aggressive forward lunge at viewer, bark mouth roars wide, both huge root-clawed arms reach forward, fingers splayed, shoulders lowered and legs braced. Distinct attack silhouette, but same scale and complete whole body including antlers and claws inside generous margins; maintain lower baseline around 94 percent height. No extra limbs, stone armor or flames. No floor, background, text, detached particles, blood or UI. Genuine transparent alpha.

Refine attached MIRE GUARDIAN attack sprite ONLY for safe game sprite framing. Leftmost and rightmost fingertip must be wholly visible with empty space outside; do not crop any root, claw, reed or antler. Extend/restore any root fingertip that touched the image edge. Keep apparent proportions and camera unchanged, no background, floor, text or new effects. Genuine transparent alpha.
